items.title: Incoming and outgoing photo-message grouping
items.precondition: An isolated local runtime is available with a conversation containing an incoming photo-only message, an outgoing photo-only message, and a captioned photo message.
steps: Open the conversation at a desktop viewport.
Hover each photo message and inspect its reaction, reply, and overflow controls.
Open the same conversation at a narrow phone viewport and reveal the controls by touch/tap.
Inspect the following message after each photo message.
items.expected: A photo that follows text does not overlap it, and text following a photo retains compact visual spacing. The established photo/menu alignment remains unchanged.
items.evidence: User tested and accepted the final layout on the local server on 2026-08-18.
items.notes: The user rejected the planned toolbar repositioning; the acceptance target was revised in Rev 9 of spec.html to preserve the original photo/menu layout.

items.title: Photo-message actions and visual variants
items.precondition: The same isolated local runtime includes an image message with a reaction and a conversation that can use a custom chat theme.
steps: Open the photo in the full-size image dialog and close it.
Use reply, reaction, and overflow-menu actions on a photo message.
Reveal the timestamp with keyboard and pointer interaction.
Repeat the layout inspection with the default and a custom chat theme.
items.expected: The lightbox and all existing actions remain operable; reaction badges, timestamps, and custom-theme contrast remain legible and attached to the correct message.
items.evidence: No interaction, lightbox, reaction, timestamp, or theme code changed in the final one-file grouping fix.
items.notes: Formal regression re-test was not separately performed after restoring the approved baseline layout.
items.waiver: Waived for this finalization: the accepted change only alters the compact-spacing predicate in ThreadViewContent; existing photo actions and visual variants were not modified.

items.title: Frontend typecheck, lint, and production build
items.precondition: The T1 and T2 implementation is present on kylie/image-sent-fix.
items.expected: Every command exits successfully, with any documented pre-existing warnings distinguished from new failures.
items.evidence: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run lint, and npm --prefix frontend run build all exited 0 on 2026-08-18.
items.notes: Lint reported six pre-existing warnings in MessageQuoteStrip, PostPhotoCommentsPage, PostDetailPage, AuthContext, and ThemeContext. Vite reported the existing client chunk-size warning. The Constitution's documented npm run check:conventions -- --strict command is not configured in this repository (missing script).
